text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analyst Kurt Abkemeier said, in a research note, that he lowered his recommendation on MobileMedia Corp to buy from strong buy "based on recently announced events that have increased the risk of the company and decreased our confidence in turnaround of performance in the near future."

-- Specifically, the company said on September 27 that because of the MobileComm acquisition, it is expecting third quarter operating cash flow of $35 million and 55,000 net adds versus J.P. Morgan's previous estimates off $42 million and 175,000 net adds.
-- Net adds are new paging subscribers, the analyst said.

-- Also, the 1997 year-end target price has been lowered to $8 per share from $21 and the 1996 earnings estimate has been cut to $3.20 per share from $3.59. The 1997 view was also lowered to $2.55 per share, from $4.03.
-- In midmorning Nasdaq trade, the shares were off 1/2 to four.
